text:
incident-bot: PAGER: dedicated-pool surge detected (pool=dedicated-eu-west-1, cpu_util=92%, queue=95). alert_id=INC-2026-0543
oncall-alex: I'm on it. getting handoff from night oncall.
oncall-oliver: Leaving handoff — spike started ~3m ago, looks correlated with Maplify traffic. They're doing lots of small batched requests.
eng-sre-maya: Repro: KV cache churn + small batched requests causing long tail latency. Suggest toggling burst capacity off to shed low-priority queued jobs.
eng-platform-raj: +1. Preparing burst toggle and tenant rate-limits. Will coordinate.
oncall-alex: Go ahead Raj. I'll notify CS.
eng-platform-raj: Running:
```
POST /admin/pools/dedicated-eu-west-1/burst_toggle
{ "enabled": false, "reason": "emergency-surge" }
```
eng-platform-raj: API returned 202 accepted.
observability-bot: metric update: queue_length down 30% in 45s after burst_toggle.
cust-success-liz: Notified Maplify support contact; they're throttling upstream and will retry non-urgent jobs.
oncall-oliver: Any customer-facing errors or data loss?
eng-sre-maya: Increased 429s for bulk endpoints, expected. No data loss. Requests are being rate-limited per policy.
oncall-alex: Let's also apply per-tenant throttle and priority routing for enterprise customers to avoid cascading failures.
eng-platform-raj: Applied routing policy to favor enterprise-tagged tenants. Also set Maplify rps -> 30. Command:
```
PATCH /config/tenants/maplify/rate_limit {"rps":30}
```
eng-sre-maya: Monitoring. If queue doesn't fall further in 5m, we may enable autoscale-burst to add capacity (+20%).
oncall-alex: I'll keep pinned. Raj, if autoscale is needed, trigger with `burst=true` flag; inform finance later.
cust-success-liz: Maplify SLA: standard. They accepted temporary throttling, no legal escalation.
observability-bot: cpu_util: 68% now; tokens/s down 40%; invoice_risk: low.
oncall-oliver: Handoff note: oncall shift in 25m, Alex stays primary.
oncall-alex: If we need to auto-scale:
```
POST /admin/pools/dedicated-eu-west-1/autoscale?burst=true&factor=1.2
```
eng-platform-raj: Canary capacity spin queued (+2 nodes) to warm kernels.
eng-sre-maya: Queue dropped below threshold, tail latencies improving. Keeping under monitoring for 30m. Tagging incident INC-2026-0543 as mitigated->monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0543 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring
oncall-alex: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
